metadata.description: The skills Harshit Khemani uses with coding agents: his own (kheskills, khe-brain) and the ones he uses from Emil Kowalski, Benji Taylor, Vercel, Lauren Tan and Matt Pocock, each served from its author's repo.

plugins.name: kheskills
plugins.description: Every khe skill except the brains, as one Claude Code plugin: /kheskills:khe-auto, /kheskills:khe-content-engine, /kheskills:khe-demo, /kheskills:khe-design-tokens, /kheskills:khe-diagram, /kheskills:khe-launch-film, /kheskills:khe-package, /kheskills:khe-poteto-pyramid, /kheskills:khe-sound, /kheskills:khe-sticker, /kheskills:khe-svg, /kheskills:khe-ui. Also four kheAgents for orchestrated work: kheskills:khe-router, kheskills:khe-executor, kheskills:khe-reviewer, kheskills:khe-pyramid. The brains are the khe-brain plugin.

plugins.name: khe-brain
plugins.description: Brains: answers from one source's public writing, talks or notes, with the source named. /khe-brain:emil-kowalski, /khe-brain:benji-taylor, /khe-brain:varun-mayya, /khe-brain:isb, /khe-brain:yc, /khe-brain:harshitkhemani, /khe-brain:enrico-tartarotti.

plugins.name: benji-taylor
plugins.description: Benji Taylor's Stageshow: faux product UI, still or animated. Served from benjitaylor/skills, not copied.

plugins.name: emil-kowalski
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's skills: UI craft, motion, gestures, mobile feel, taste. Served from emilkowalski/skills, not copied.

plugins.name: matt-pocock
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills: deep modules, diagnosis, domain models, specs, guardrails. Served from mattpocock/skills, not copied.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Lauren Tan's (poteto) pstack, the Claude Code build Cursor generates from her Cursor plugin: /pstack:poteto-mode, /pstack:correct and the rest. Served from cursor/plugins, not copied.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel's agent skills: React and Next.js performance, composition, deploying, the web interface and writing guidelines. Served from vercel-labs/agent-skills, not copied.

plugins.name: vercel-ui-sdk
plugins.description: Vercel's UI SDK skill, and the UI SDK repository's own contributor skills. Served from vercel-labs/ui, not copied.
